lines.e1: Scrum assumes we cannot predict a complex project, so it asks us to learn from experience.
lines.e2: Steering by evidence beats following a plan that was only a guess.
lines.e3: Transparency: everyone sees the real state of the work.
lines.e4: Inspection: we check progress often enough to catch problems early.
lines.e5: Adaptation: when something is off, we change course straight away.
lines.d1: Without transparency, inspection is misleading. Without inspection, adaptation is blind.
lines.d2: Together they let a team learn fast and reduce risk.
lines.outro: See it. Check it. Change it.
